structured_output.summary: Diff implements Date.prototype.getHours in its own file, following the spec steps. Step 1-3 are delegated to `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which propagates the abrupt completion. Step 4 returns NaN when tv is NaN. Step 5 returns Value::Number(hour_from_time(local_time(agent, tv))). No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values. The gate reports 8 new passing test262 runs with 0 regressions. Only one file changed. The removed header comment and the underscore-renamed unused parameters are cosmetic. I could not see the helper module, so whether `this_time_value` performs RequireInternalSlot (TypeError for non-Date objects) is inferred, not verified from this diff.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing blocking. Before merging, confirm in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/support/date (not shown in this diff) that `this_time_value` throws a TypeError when `this` is not an object or lacks [[DateValue]] (spec RequireInternalSlot, steps 1-2), and that `local_time` and `hour_from_time` match the spec's LocalTime and HourFromTime. Cosmetic: the "This method performs the following steps when called:" header comment was dropped; the stub convention keeps it, so restoring it would match the other files.
